hook: Bleached anemones made clownfish more aggressive, but the fish kept tending their host.
hook_turn: but the fish kept tending their host.
summary: Clownfish living in bleached anemones fought more within their groups and acted more defensively, while time spent with the anemone stayed high. Researchers compared video of fish on bleached and unbleached hosts during a marine heatwave. The data come from one heatwave in one bay, so other species and events may differ.
title: Anemonefish prioritize mutualistic partner over social group during a marine heatwave.
